title: Noninvasive Assessment of Neuromuscular Disease Using Electrical Impedance Myography
brief_summary: The purpose of this protocol is to test a new Electrical Impedance Myography (EIM) device and study its reliability and ability to differentiate ALS patients from healthy controls.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of probable or definite ALS by the El Escorial Criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of superimposed generalized neuromuscular disease
* Primary lateral sclerosis or other atypical motor neuron disorders
* Forced vital capacity of less than 50%
* Presence of disease for greater than 5 years since symptom onset
